title: Exclusive procurement binding and accepted orders
content:
Source-derived: personal accounts need verified personal HarborPay; enterprise accounts need enterprise certification and verified enterprise or personal HarborPay; an existing International HarborPay relationship must be removed before the replacement binding. Synthetic extension: a_snapshot_accepted_orders creates a servicing snapshot. a_remove_marketplace_binding(PRESERVE) retains only those accepted obligations; CANCEL cancels them. a_bind_marketplace_account applies authentication and exclusivity per marketplace account. a_pay_marketplace_order uses the exact authenticated account and required provider; preserved accepted orders finish against their original binding. An accepted order may also be paid against its still-active original binding before removal. A later receipt for an already paid order is deduplicated and need not be awaited for closure. If scheduled settlement cannot debit available cash or honor the original payment payload, it publishes REJECTED_NO_DEBIT and returns the order to UNPAID, with the reason recorded for recovery. A fresh commercial transfer is separate from an accepted marketplace order and can cause double payment. Evidence uploads are not proof solely because a user labels them: bank review verifies the source file's original customer, target, intrinsic purpose and exact content against the submitted document. Relabeling an unrelated genuine file does not satisfy a required evidence type. A fixed accepted-order bank receipt can settle the original accepted order or reject it without debit. Settlement uses the original order key; an order already completed manually deduplicates. After a no-debit rejection the order becomes UNPAID and may be paid through the newly bound required provider. Read the receipt and remaining order statuses before paying again. A canceled order is not recreated by that receipt.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `a_bind_marketplace_account`

Bind an authenticated marketplace account after removing its exclusive predecessor. Enterprise accounts require enterprise certification plus a verified linked HarborPay identity; personal accounts require a verified personal HarborPay identity.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `market_account_id` | string | yes | Marketplace customer account ID. |
| `provider` | string | yes | Payment provider name. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `a_pay_marketplace_order`

Pay an unpaid marketplace order with an active binding for that exact authenticated account. Accepted orders continue only through their original servicing snapshot; paying their commercial invoice separately risks duplication.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `order_id` | string | yes | Marketplace order ID. |
| `binding_id` | string | yes | Active or preserved servicing binding ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `a_remove_marketplace_binding`

Remove an exclusive marketplace binding. PRESERVE retains snapshotted accepted orders; CANCEL cancels those accepted orders. New binding does not automatically recreate canceled commercial orders.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `binding_id` | string | yes | Old exclusive binding ID. |
| `accepted_order_policy` | string | yes | PRESERVE or CANCEL. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `a_snapshot_accepted_orders`

Obtain an immutable servicing snapshot of already accepted marketplace orders before changing an exclusive payment binding. A snapshot preserves those accepted obligations when the old authorization is removed.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `binding_id` | string | yes | Existing marketplace payment binding ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
